description: Independently rehash every declared {repo-relative path: SHA-256} entry beneath a named absolute worktree or candidate-tree root and return exact, mismatch, or missing for each file. The manifest is validated before any file is read; paths cannot escape the root through traversal or a symlink. The verb also reports when a scratch worktree's .venv or editable-install pointer resolves source outside that root, the worktree-shadowing class tracked by iss_60621400. It never stages, commits, merges, or otherwise mutates Git.
embedding_description: Verify a landing file manifest by SHA-256 in a named worktree or candidate tree. Reports per-file exact/mismatch/missing evidence and warns if editable Python installs resolve back to another checkout, which can make a scratch gate test the wrong source. Read-only; no Git mutation.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Object with unit_id, root_path, files [{path, expected_sha256, actual_sha256|null, status}], all_exact, editable_install_warnings, and editable_install_shadowing_detected.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with all_exact and any missing/mismatch paths. Surface editable_install_shadowing_detected prominently: a true value means a Python gate may have imported code from outside the declared root.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: This is evidence only. Do not infer landing authorization or mutate Git from a passing result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reading declared files and Python editable-install pointers under an absolute worktree/candidate-tree root.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValueError means the root, manifest digest, or declared relative path was invalid or escaped the root. A per-file missing or mismatch is returned as a normal report result, not an invocation error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the root/path/digest declaration and rerun. For a mismatch or missing path, repair the candidate manifest or file surface; for editable-install warnings, run the gate using a venv whose pointers resolve into the declared root.
